_note: MOCK data for the project, realistic but not authoritative. Visa rules are for a TUNISIAN passport. Prices in TND. Used by src/mock_api/service.py (get_visa_info, get_payment_info, get_car_rental).

visa.note: No visa or passport needed for travel inside Tunisia.

payment.cards: accepted in hotels, big shops, malls and many restaurants
payment.cash: needed in souks, small cafes, louages and most taxis
payment.atm: common in cities and tourist areas, rare in small villages
payment.tipping: round up in cafes and taxis, about 10% in tourist restaurants
payment.note: The dinar is a closed currency: it cannot be bought abroad. Exchange at the airport or a bank and keep the receipts to change money back.

driving.licence: Tunisian driving licence held for at least 2 years
driving.note: Fuel is cheap; watch for speed checks on main roads.
